doc_structure: [{"node":"menu_content106","element":"menu_content","data":{"label":"Docs Kitchen Screen","key":"docs_kitchen_screen_menu_content","id":"docs_kitchen_screen_menu_content","name":"docs_kitchen_screen_menu_content"},"elements":[{"node":"markdown101","element":"markdown","data":{"label":"Kitchen screen","key":"md_kitchen_screen","id":"kitchen-screen","name":"md_kitchen_screen","value":" # Kitchen screen Every production center has a screen with what it has to prepare, oldest first. Open it from the **production column** on the right of the floor plan (on phones, the **Production** bar at the bottom). Kitchen staff who only have stations open the POS straight on them. A tablet on the wall, a screen over the pass, or a phone all work. "}},{"node":"markdown102","element":"markdown","data":{"label":"The steps bar","key":"md_the_steps_bar","id":"the-steps-bar","name":"md_the_steps_bar","value":"# The steps bar The top bar shows the station's flow as steps, with how many items are at each: *Waiting 3 — Cooking 1 — Ready 2*. Tap a step to see only its tickets; tap it again (or **Show all**) to see everything. The last step counts what left the screen in the last 30 minutes and opens **Recall**."}},{"node":"markdown103","element":"markdown","data":{"label":"Tickets","key":"md_tickets","id":"tickets","name":"md_tickets","value":"# Tickets - One card per order (with **Group Items By Order**) or per item, with the table, room, guests, server and how long it has been waiting. - The items, their options (*NO Tomato · Medium*) and notes, as the waiter entered them. - **Round 2, 3…**: items sent later for the same order arrive as a new round. - The status and a button with the **action of the next status**: *Start* moves the items to *Processing*, *Complete* to *Completed*. At the last status of the station's flow the ticket leaves the screen. Tap the button once: if another screen already moved the ticket, it refreshes instead of moving it twice."}},{"node":"markdown104","element":"markdown","data":{"label":"Other tools","key":"md_other_tools","id":"other-tools","name":"md_other_tools","value":"# Other tools - **Recall**: the last moves at this station. **Undo** puts a ticket back to its previous status (only the latest move of each item, and only from the station that made it). - **Voided — stop preparing**: when a waiter voids something already sent, it shows in red for a while, with the reason and who voided it. - **Sound on new tickets**: the bell icon mutes or unmutes the chime. - The screen updates by itself as orders are sent and moved; **Refresh** forces it."}},{"node":"markdown105","element":"markdown","data":{"label":"What reaches this screen","key":"md_what_reaches_this_screen","id":"what-reaches-this-screen","name":"md_what_reaches_this_screen","value":"# What reaches this screen The items of the station's **item groups**, from the rooms or tables it is limited to, in the statuses of its flow. A combo's parts can go to different stations. See [Production centers](/Docs/Production%20Centers). If something is missing, see [Troubleshooting](/Docs/Troubleshooting#nothing-reaches-a-kitchen-screen)."}}]}]
